subject: Sliding versus hinged wardrobe doors
hook: Fitted wardrobes with sliding or hinged doors, chosen for your room rather than a catalogue.
gbp:
Not sure whether sliding or hinged wardrobe doors suit your bedroom? That is one of the first things we work out together at a free design consultation.

Sliding doors suit rooms where the bed sits close to the wardrobe, because there is no swing space to allow for. Hinged doors suit rooms with more floor space and people who want to see the whole wardrobe at once, with drawers and shelving placed wherever they work best. We help you weigh up the floor space, what you need to store and the look you want, then design the interior to match: hanging rails, shelves, drawers and shoe storage.

SUPERIO fitted wardrobes are made to measure in our own workshop in Hanley, in finishes from matt white and charcoal to oak-effect and black woodgrain, with antique gold or matt black handles and soft-close hardware as standard. Our own team installs them, including scribing to walls and ceilings that are not quite straight.

We fit wardrobes in homes in Leek and across Staffordshire. Tap the button below to see our fitted wardrobes and arrange your consultation.
